operations.description: This API is used to cancel a packaging task. Only tasks in the queue can be canceled.
## Typical Scenarios ## ## Functions ## ## Constraints ##

This API is used to create an animated GIF task to convert a complete video file or part of a video file into an animated GIF file. Ensure that an input media file is stored in an OBS bucket in the same region as MPC and the permission to access the OBS bucket has been granted.
This API is used to create a task to parse the metadata of a video file.

This API is used to create a packaging task. Packaging is to convert the container format of audio and video files without changing the resolution and bitrate. Ensure that an input media file is stored in an OBS bucket in the same region as MPC and the permission to access the OBS bucket has been granted.
This API is used to retry a failed packaging task.
This API is used to create a transcoding template group. In a custom transcoding template group, a maximum of six output configurations can be defined.

This API is used to create a snapshot task to capture snapshots from a video at every set interval.Ensure that an input media file is stored in an OBS bucket in the same region as MPC and the permission to access the OBS bucket has been granted. Constraints: Currently, only animated GIF files can be generated.
This API is used to create a transcoding template.

This API is used to create a transcoding task to transcode media files, and add watermarks and capture snapshots during transcoding. A transcoding template must be configured before video transcoding. Ensure that an input media file is stored in an OBS bucket in the same region as MPC and the permission for accessing the OBS bucket has been granted to MPC.
This API is used to create a watermark template.
This API is used to cancel an animated GIF task. Only tasks in the queue can be canceled.
This API is used to cancel a video parsing task. Only tasks in the queue can be canceled.
Only the records in Canceled, Transcoding succeeded, or Transcoding failed state can be deleted.
This API is used to delete a custom transcoding template.
This API is used to delete a custom transcoding template group.
This API is used to cancel a snapshot task.
This API is used to cancel a transcoding task. You can only cancel the queuing transcoding tasks. A transcoding task that has started or completed cannot be canceled.
This API is used to delete a watermark template.
This API is used to query one or more animated GIF tasks.
This API is used to query the status and results of one or more video parsing tasks.
